headline: SILVER SURGES FROM 8-MONTH LOW AS FED HOLDS RATES — Metal Reclaims $58 After FOMC; Gold Defends $4,000 Floor Through Four Tests in Two Weeks
snippet: Following the July 29 Federal Reserve decision to hold interest rates steady, silver rebounded sharply from near its 8-month low — the metal had touched $55.50 on July 17 and spent two weeks testing the $57 area — recovering above $58 on the FOMC session. Gold held the psychologically critical $4,000 support level, a floor that has now been tested four times since mid-July without breaking. The combination of a Fed hold, persistent geopolitical risk from the US-Iran situation, and silver's structural supply deficit (46.3 million ounces projected for 2026 — the sixth consecutive year of undersupply) provided enough fundamental footing for the relief rally that silver bulls had been waiting for.

headline: CENTERRA GOLD Q2: REVENUE SURGES 54% TO $442.7M — Öksüt Guidance Raised 9%; $200M Buyback Approved; Liquidity Reaches $1.05B (TSX/NYSE: CG/CGAU)
snippet: Centerra Gold reported Q2 2026 revenue of $442.7 million — up 54% year-over-year — as its Öksüt gold mine in Turkey produced 70,727 ounces in the quarter, strong enough to prompt a 9% upward revision to full-year annual production guidance. The board approved an expanded share buyback program to $200 million in 2026 after completing $50 million in Q2, and liquidity reached $1.05 billion following a credit facility expansion. The pattern reinforces the theme emerging from this earnings season: gold producers are generating cash significantly faster than their market multiples reflect, with operations consistently outperforming guidance while the sector trades at discounts not seen since mid-2022.

headline: AMAROQ NALUNAQ GROWS TO 504,000 oz AU AT 30.35 g/t — Greenland's Highest-Grade Operating Mine Gets Fifth Resource Update Ahead of LSE Main Board Listing (AIM: AMRQ)
snippet: Amaroq Ltd. released its fifth mineral resource estimate for the 100%-owned Nalunaq gold mine in South Greenland on July 29, growing total contained gold to 504,000 ounces at an average grade of 30.35 g/t Au — comprising 174,000 ounces in the Indicated category and 329,000 ounces Inferred. The update was independently prepared by Bara Consulting with an effective December 2025 date, and accompanies an updated Competent Persons Report for the full Amaroq portfolio ahead of the company's proposed graduation from AIM to the London Stock Exchange main market. At 30+ g/t, Nalunaq is one of the highest-grade gold operations in the world; the resource growth and LSE move are simultaneous catalysts for re-rating.

headline: WEST POINT GOLD HITS 62.5m @ 3.1 g/t INCL. 38.1m @ 4.66 g/t AT NE TYRO — High-Grade Continuity Confirmed 230m Deep as Maiden Resource Approaches (TSXV: WPG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / West Point Gold
snippet: West Point Gold Corp. (TSXV: WPG) reported July 29 that drill hole GC26-166 at the NE Tyro vein system intersected 62.5 metres of 3.1 g/t gold from 233 metres downhole, including a high-grade core of 38.1 metres at 4.66 g/t Au. The hole was collared approximately 20 metres in front of a previous result that returned 66 metres at 6.57 g/t, confirming lateral continuity in the vein corridor. The Gold Chain Project in southern British Columbia is continuously mineralised from surface to at least 230 metres vertical depth at NE Tyro, and West Point is advancing toward a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate later in 2026 — thick intercepts at consistently high grade are exactly what resource estimates are built on.

headline: COPPER GIANT HITS 584m @ 0.73% CuEq AT MOCOA — High-Grade Core 183m @ 0.94%; La Estrella First Assay Proves System Extends South (TSXV: CGNT)
snippet: Copper Giant Resources Corp. (TSXV: CGNT) released July 28 results from infill hole MD-066 at its Mocoa copper-molybdenum porphyry in Colombia's Putumayo Department: 584 continuous metres of 0.73% CuEq (0.40% Cu and 0.062% Mo), including a high-grade core of 183 metres at 0.94% CuEq — well above the current MRE average of 0.51% CuEq. The first assay from the company's third rig, corridor hole MD-065 collared at the La Estrella target, returned 176 metres of 0.30% CuEq from 610 metres outside the existing resource footprint, confirming that one of the Americas' largest undeveloped copper systems (12.7 billion pounds CuEq) continues beyond its currently defined boundary.

headline: WESTHAVEN SHOVELNOSE 4TH BATCH: 27.51m @ 14.47 g/t AU AND 52 g/t AG — Fifth Rig Added to Flagship BC Gold-Silver Infill Program (TSXV: WGT)
snippet: The fourth batch of assay results from Westhaven Gold Corp.'s (TSXV: WGT) 35,000-metre resource infill program at the Shovelnose Gold and Silver Property in southern British Columbia was released July 28, with drill hole SNR26-99 returning 27.51 metres grading 14.47 g/t gold and 52.3 g/t silver — one of the highest grade-thickness results in the current campaign. A sub-interval of 0.52 metres at 200 g/t gold represents the highest single assay to date across all infill holes. A fifth diamond drill rig has been mobilised to test the 15,000-metre exploration program on the broader Shovelnose property, running through mid-December.

headline: NOBLE PLAINS DRILLS SHIRLEY BASIN — AI Converts 1,211 Historical Gamma Logs Into 341 Modern Uranium Intercepts; First Holes Now Turning Adjacent to UEC Ground (TSXV: NOBL)
snippet: Noble Plains Uranium Corp. (TSXV: NOBL) mobilised a drill rig to Wyoming's Shirley Basin on July 28 for a seven-hole confirmation program targeting historical roll-front uranium intercepts. The company deployed Geomorphic AI's computer vision pipeline to digitise 1,211 historical gamma-ray logs from 1950s–1970s exploration campaigns — previously stored as scanned images unusable in modern resource workflows — identifying 341 qualifying uranium intercepts across coherent roll-front trends. A successful twin drill program opens the path to an NI 43-101 resource estimate. The property borders Uranium Energy Corp. (UEC) ground in one of Wyoming's most active ISR uranium corridors.

headline: SILVER ELEPHANT FINDS 539 g/t AG OVER 10m AT OPERATING BOLIVIAN MINE — New Zone Discovered in Active Underground Workings at Apuradita (TSX: ELEF)
snippet: Silver Elephant Mining Corp. (TSX: ELEF) announced July 27 the discovery of a new high-grade silver mineralised zone in the underground workings of its producing Apuradita project in Bolivia, with a continuous 10-metre channel sampling interval averaging 539 g/t silver — individual 2-metre samples ranged from 109 g/t to 838 g/t. The zone sits at 4,216 metres elevation, approximately 21 metres below surface. Silver Elephant is currently in production at Apuradita using shrinkage stoping and shipping silver concentrate via toll milling at 400–600 tonnes of ore per month, making this an in-mine discovery rather than a greenfield one — a potentially faster path to expanded revenue.

headline: MOTLEY FOOL: BUY THESE 2 RARE EARTH STOCKS, SELL THIS ONE — Western Mine-to-Magnet Push Separates Winners From Losers as China Tightens Export Controls
snippet: Motley Fool's July 29 rare earth analysis identifies two companies positioned to benefit from US-China supply chain decoupling and one that remains structurally disadvantaged, as China's export restrictions on heavy rare earths (including dysprosium, terbium, and NdPr precursors) continue to tighten. The piece argues that the critical differentiator in the current environment is integrated domestic processing capacity: companies that can produce finished magnets or alloys inside the US without Chinese feedstock inputs are gaining pricing power, while those still dependent on Chinese refining have a structural ceiling on their margin expansion.

headline: GOLD AT $4,000: FOUR KEY LEVELS TO WATCH THROUGH FOMC WEEK — How Junior Miners Are Priced vs. $4K Gold Is the Setup Every Retail Investor Should Understand
snippet: Canadian Mining Report's weekly technical outlook for July 27–31 maps four key support and resistance levels for gold in the $4,000 area, noting that the metal's ability to hold its January correction lows while major producers continue delivering record margins creates the textbook setup for a junior mining re-rating — but only if the FOMC statement avoids signalling additional rate hikes. The analysis argues that junior gold miners are currently trading at the largest discount to spot gold in the post-2020 bull market, creating a structural entry opportunity for investors willing to tolerate the sector's liquidity risk ahead of what could be an explosive H2 2026 if rate expectations shift.
